headline: Index and software strength drive double-digit growth
summary_short: Net revenue rose 13% y/y to $1,481M and GAAP diluted EPS rose 31% to $0.96 ($1.04 non-GAAP, +18%), with record Index net inflows and ARR of $3.4B.
summary_long: Solutions revenue grew 17%. Index revenue grew 39% with $49B of net inflows in the quarter and $141B over twelve months. Annualized recurring revenue grew 12% to $3.4B, with SaaS 38% of ARR. Market Services net revenue rose 2% to $309M. Nasdaq returned $173M through dividends and $323M through buybacks in the quarter, and more than $1.7B year to date. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Net revenue is revenue less transaction-based expenses. Non-GAAP EPS and operating income exclude amortization and other items. Percent changes are as stated in the release.

drivers.explanation: Record net inflows into Nasdaq-linked index products: $141 billion over the trailing twelve months, including $49 billion in the quarter.
Release cites record FinTech ARR growth; Solutions revenue overall grew 17%.
CFO cites outstanding Solutions revenue growth, continued operating leverage and strong EPS growth.
